title: NewsBody
description: Bronze record — one immutable body version, stored once and content-addressed by SHA-256; unchanged bodies are never re-stored and edited bodies append a new version (PRD ingestion, AC1.4, AC1.7).

body_hash.description: Content address — SHA-256 (hex) over the exact UTF-8 bytes of raw_text; storage key news_item.body_hash resolves to (AC1.7).

raw_text.description: Full original text of this body version; never empty — uncaptured bodies are not stored here (AC1.4).

first_seen_at.description: Timestamp when this body version was first observed (AC1.7).

first_seen_cycle.description: Collection cycle in which this body version was first observed (AC1.7).
